appDescription: KKAEUM is a drowsy-driving prevention copilot that estimates driver alertness and plans rest stops and power naps.

function.name: GET_ALERTNESS_STATUS
function.description: Returns the driver's current estimated alertness level and the recommended time until the next break.

function.name: ADD_REST_STOP
function.description: Adds the most suitable upcoming rest area or drowsy-driving shelter on the current route as a navigation waypoint.

function.name: START_POWER_NAP
function.description: Starts a guided power nap with cabin climate, seat and lighting adjusted, only while the vehicle is parked.

function.name: CANCEL_REST_STOP
function.description: Removes the rest stop KKAEUM previously added as a navigation waypoint, when the driver no longer needs the break.
